prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference images 1 and 2 are vanilla Card Survival neck charms, used as STYLE and LAYOUT references: a plain carved pendant hanging point down from two plain brown leather cords that rise in a narrow V toward the top of the frame. Match their layout, their flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outline and muted colours; do not copy their carvings.
Draw: a Dragon Charm. One single off-white reptile fang, gently curved, about three times as long as it is wide at its thick top end, hanging point down, off-white bone with warm grey-beige shading, a small tied knot of cord at its thick top end. Scratched shallowly into its surface in a few simple dark incised lines is a plain serpent: one wavy line with a small head, running down the length of the fang. The carving is crude, flat and folk-like, like the eyes and nose cut into reference image 1, not a raised sculpted dragon.
Style: plain vanilla Card Survival game art: flat colour fills in three or four tonal steps, a thin continuous dark brown-black ink outline, muted natural colours, no glossy highlights, no decorative patterns, no cartoon, no comic shading. Single object only, the fang in the lower half of the frame, the cords rising toward the top, comfortably inset from the side and bottom edges, isolated on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills every edge of the frame, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: a raised three-dimensional dragon sculpture, a dragon coiled around the fang, wings, realistic animal, cute face, beads, feathers, metal, gold, gems, ornate border, swirls, filigree, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, cartoon, comic book, glossy highlights, multiple objects, cropped, blurry, grey background, off-white background, gradient background, checkerboard, transparency grid, scenery, drop shadow, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, footprints, tracks.
